correctness.rationale: Multiplying N by itself gives the six target entries and the free corner. When a=d=0 the remaining constraints give the outer product (b,e)^T(c,g); zero and nonzero rank-one outputs have respectively 2q²−1 and q−1 factorizations. Otherwise the final equation contributes q choices for (h,i). For B≠0 one can choose b and f, with c, a, d, e, g then fixed; for B=0 and A alone nonzero, c=0, b is nonzero, a and f are determined, d and e are free, and g is fixed (the C case is symmetric). When A=B=C=0 and (a,d)≠(0,0), b≠0 forces D=0 and contributes q⁴(q−1)², c≠0 gives its mirror, and b=c=0 leaves (D,E)=f(a,d). This reproduces all strata, including the exceptional identity. The five positive sizes are strictly ordered for q≥2. The only forbidden targets within the six coordinates number q²(q−1)²+q³(q−1)², giving the stated image polynomial. An independent complete enumeration matched every target for q=2,4,8 (including all 262,144 targets for q=8) and total mass q^10.
residual_risks: Only the symbolic proof, not the finite replay, treats all even prime powers.
